name: Yokaze Yuse
source:
Second-year student and childhood friend of the protagonist. Member of the Virtual Activities Club. [url=/c160967]Lucy[/url]'s daughter.

She's a girl who lives nearby. Like Mashiro, she's highly dependendent on the protagonist, always trying to look after him. She's rivals with Mashiro and extremely good at cooking. Her kindness makes it hard for her to say no when her friends ask for help.

She's known as the school idol, a one-in-120-million kind of girl.

She's the model student, but while she clearly treats the protagonist as special, she'd never admit she has feelings for him.

Her real name is Takarazuki Pikariko, but she chooses to go by Yokaze Yuse. She has a deep inferiority complex about her real name and is determined to change it. She gets upset if anyone but the protagonist calls her by it.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/02.html]official website[/url]]
